title: 8.1.4 Lab: Drill a Hole
description: Pick a face and drill a hole through it with the Hole tool. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Click the top face of the box
steps.instructions: You're starting from a 40 x 40 x 20 mm box. Click the flat top face of the box in the 3D view to select it. The hole you drill next goes through whichever face you pick.
hints: Click near the middle of the top face, not near an edge or corner.

steps.title: Drill the hole
steps.instructions: Press the Hole tool in the toolbar. A hole appears through the top of the box. In the Dimensions panel, the diameter reads 6 — type 12 to change it.
hints: The Hole tool's tooltip reads "Pick one shape to use" until you have a face selected.
The new step shows up in the timeline as "Hole 1".
Look for the field named "Hole 1 diameter" in the Dimensions panel.

requirements.title: A 12 mm hole through the box
requirements.description: The box has a hole 12 mm across, drilled through the top face.
requirements.hint: Click the top face, then press Hole. Check that the diameter field reads 12.
